mature.title: Mature content
mature.body: Show stories with mature themes. They’re hidden until you turn this on.
mature.confirmBody: These stories can include themes that some people find upsetting. They never include explicit sexual content.

aiConsents.title: AI and your data
aiConsents.intro: You can turn each one off any time. Turning one off stops that feature from using AI.

story.title: AI stories
story.body: Send what you write and your choices to AI models from Meta to make your story. Narration may be read by a voice model from Google.

upload.title: Checking uploads
upload.body: Let AI from Meta read your uploaded videos to add captions and tags and check them for safety.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.body: Send your voice to an AI model from Meta to turn it into text.

captionsDefault.title: Captions
captionsDefault.body: Show captions when a video starts.

legal.title: Legal
legal.creator: Creator Terms
legal.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this page. Please try again.

support.title: Report a problem
support.body: Tell us what went wrong and we’ll look into it.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This removes your account and everything you made. Some records we’re required to keep by law stay, without your name where we can.
delete.whatGoesBody: Your profile, library, stories and uploads.
delete.whatStaysBody: Records of payments and tax that the law requires.

subscription.title: Your subscription is still active
subscription.body: Deleting your account doesn’t stop your {{store}} subscription. It keeps billing until you cancel it.
subscription.bodyUnnamed: Deleting your account doesn’t stop your subscription. It keeps billing until you cancel it.
subscription.bodyGeneric: Deleting your account doesn’t cancel it. It keeps billing until you cancel it in the store you subscribed through.

delete.confirmHint: Type the word exactly as shown.
delete.failed: We couldn’t start the deletion. Please try again.
delete.done: Your account is being deleted. You’ve been signed out.
delete.signOutFailed: Your account is being deleted. Sign out to finish on this device.

blocked.title: Blocked accounts
blocked.intro: People you block don’t show up for you, and their stories are hidden. You can unblock them here.
blocked.unblockA11y: Unblock the account you blocked on {{date}}
